title: VK-only Read Command with link start prerequisite and compact read ASDU analogue
purpose: Exercise a server-side Read Command path with a valid link-start prerequisite and a short, conservative I-frame whose ASDU remains internally sized but close to minimal parsing boundaries relevant to queue and short-body handling analogues.
expected_behavior: Implementation should accept or cleanly reject the link-start plus Read Command sequence without queue traversal confusion, out-of-bounds access, or malformed short-body acceptance beyond intended parser checks.
constraints_preserved: Visible length octets consistent with frame sizes
Target operation preserved as Read Command
Stateful multi-step sequence increases diversity beyond single U-frame
No exact historical crash payload reused
issue_safety_notes: Uses a conservative compact read-style ASDU after activation as a safe structural analogue only; it avoids the reported long crash stream and does not copy any supplied PoC bytes.
